```python
from typing import List
import pytest


def filter_by_substring(strings: List[str], substring: str) -> List[str]:
    return [x for x in strings if substring in x]


def test_filter_by_substring():
    # basic match
    assert filter_by_substring(["apple", "banana", "cherry"], "an") == ["banana"]
    # multiple matches, order preserved
    assert filter_by_substring(["cat", "bat", "car"], "ca") == ["cat", "car"]
    # no matches
    assert filter_by_substring(["apple", "banana"], "zzz") == []
    # empty input list
    assert filter_by_substring([], "a") == []
    # empty substring matches everything
    assert filter_by_substring(["a", "b"], "") == ["a", "b"]
    # substring at start / end
    assert filter_by_substring(["hello", "shell", "help"], "hel") == ["hello", "help"]
    assert filter_by_substring(["hello", "shell", "help"], "ell") == ["hello", "shell"]
    # case sensitivity
    assert filter_by_substring(["Apple", "apple"], "app") == ["apple"]
    # empty strings in input
    assert filter_by_substring(["", "a"], "") == ["", "a"]
    assert filter_by_substring(["", "a"], "a") == ["a"]
```
